Add-ons

The treatment add-ons price by what they treat (v16): oil stain treatment at $0.12 and efflorescence / calcium at $0.20 per sq ft of treated area only — the treated sq ft is entered on the add-on’s row on the quote, never priced on the whole flatwork — and rust removal at a flat $60 per stain, priced by stain count. Sealer still prices per sq ft of flatwork. Any add-on can be priced flat, per sq ft of flatwork, per treated sq ft, or per stain. Rename, reprice, or add your own.

Paver system rates — driveway on pavers

Shown as toggleable lines on the quote whenever the driveway surface is pavers. The $0.50 re-sand default is a placeholder — calibrate it to your market. The $1.00 sealer default is the midpoint of the national seal-only range ($0.50–$1.50). The “Containment & recovery” add-on above defaults to $0 — set your rate, it varies by job.

Quote extras

Trip fee and preferred job date for the quote you are building.

The out-of-area trip fee is added only when the “Out-of-area trip fee” toggle is switched on in the quote (default off, 10–20 mi). The job minimum floors any quote whose discounted subtotal falls below it — tax is then charged on the floored amount. It is separate from the per-service Window Cleaning minimum.

Per-window prices for the Window Cleaning service (v16 defaults: Both $12, Outside $7, Inside $7). The window count comes from Property basics at the top of the quote; inside / outside is picked on the service itself. A $150 windows-service minimum applies whenever windows are on the quote — set it under “Service rates & minimums” on the Window Cleaning row.

Tiered bundle discount (v16): applied automatically, once per quote, when a quote bundles 2 or more services. It stacks with any extra discount entered on the quote itself.

Cities & tax rates

Tax follows the city picked on the quote and auto-matches the city in the client’s address. Rates are combined state, county, and city — edit any rate to match what you charge.

How pricing works

How the pricing works

Transparent math, so you can defend every number when a customer pushes back.

Base rate × condition

Each service starts at a per-sq-ft rate (commercial runs lower per foot, higher minimums). Heavy buildup multiplies the rate — heavy oil and years of desert calcium shouldn’t price like a light rinse.

Minimums protect you

Every service carries a job minimum. A 200 sq ft patio still costs a trip, setup, and teardown — the calculator never lets a tiny job price itself into a loss.

Add-ons carry the day

Sealer, rust, and efflorescence work is specialty chemical + know-how. That’s why it’s priced separately instead of buried in the wash rate.

Settings save on this device and apply to every quote. They don’t sync to other devices.

Install SprayQuote

Installs from your browser — no app store. Open this page in Safari, Chrome, or Edge, then follow the steps for your device.

iPhone / iPad Safari

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
  3. Tap Add to Home Screen — if you don’t see it, tap the … More button in the Share sheet first, then Add to Home Screen.
  4. Tap Add — “SprayQuote” lands on your home screen.

Android Chrome

  1. Open this page in Chrome and tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
  2. Tap Install app.
  3. Tap Install to confirm.
  4. Only see Add to Home screen in the menu? That adds a shortcut, not the app — it still opens the calculator, but for the full app, reopen this page in up-to-date Chrome and look for Install app.

Windows / Mac Chrome or Edge

  1. Chrome: click the install icon at the right end of the address bar — or open the ⋮ menu → Cast, save, and share → Install page as app…
  2. Edge: open the … menu → Apps → Install this site as an app.
  3. Click Install — it opens in its own window and pins like any program.

Once installed, it opens full-screen and works offline.
